text:
mia_marketing: Planning to announce Quasar next Friday 09:00 PT. Need: final changelog link, canonical staging docs URL (staging ok), a single hero benchmark sentence, canary & ramp windows, and webinar ownership for a 30-min product demo. Also two subject lines for an A/B email test. :satellite:

raj_eng: I'll push the changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/642 (final sha `4f7b2c9`). Canary plan: 09:00 PT canary 6m, 20% at 09:06, 50% at 09:14, full at 09:30. Fallback tag: quasar-legacy. Ops should be on standby for 20m after full.

sara_docs: Staging docs live at https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/quasar  I've added Quickstart + Migration guide. I'll paste the migration config snippet and a one-line hero copy here when ready. Marketing, please use this as the canonical docs link in the announcement.

omar_research: Benchmark blurb candidate: "Quasar cuts token cost by up to 2.2x on long-context workloads and reduces p95 latency by ~48% at 16k tokens." I'll run a final overnight regression and confirm the exact percent by 07:30 PT tomorrow. If numbers shift we'll use conservative wording ("up to"). :bar_chart:

mia_marketing: Great. Webinar: Evan, can you lead the demo? We'll aim for the same day 11:00 PT, 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. For email A/B subject lines: A) "Quasar: Faster long-context LLMs, lower token cost" B) "Meet Quasar  up to 2.2x lower token spend" Thoughts?

ev an_pm: I can lead the demo; Sara will demo migration and Omar will handle the benchmark Qs. I'll own the runbook and rollback steps and publish the link in this thread. Email at +5m after full rollout is fine; Growth will segment recipients.

raj_eng: Runbook snippet for ops: rollback command `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=10`. Post-rollout checks: `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.dev/model-route | jq .p95` and KV cache hit-rate dashboard. Add a post-rollout smoke to verify p50/p95 on the default route.

sara_docs: Migration snippet (to paste in docs):

```
# quasar example config
model:
  id: redwood-quasar
  quant_mode: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```

omar_research: Regression started; will confirm final benchmark line by 07:30 PT. If confirmed I'll also provide a 1-sentence explainer suitable for the blog hero.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-quasar start=5771234400 canary_window=360s full_rollout=5771235000 CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

mia_marketing: Proposed publish timeline: 09:00 PT canary, 09:30 full, 09:35 blog + docs live, 09:40 public email (A/B), 09:45 VIP notify, 09:50 social posts, 11:00 webinar. I'll draft the announcement and post it here by EOD for sign-off. Final checklist: merged changelog link, staging docs URL, benchmark confirmation, runbook + rollback, webinar deck, email subject A/B. Ping this thread with any last-minute changes. :rocket:
